source_native_dimensions: initial posting, update, change, resolved and discontinued dates
invariants: Absence from a current shortage list is not evidence that no historical shortage occurred.
Current, resolved and discontinued are retained as source-native states.
No medicine identity normalization or historical-state inference is performed in Bronze.
Historical list pages remain distinct temporal snapshots of the official FDA surface.
limitations: The complete current openFDA export and all 129 monthly list-page captures inventoried from June 2014 through August 2026 are privately archived.
The delegated archive exposes metadata for 35,494 distinct detail-page payload captures, but no complete historical detail-page denominator was identified in the reviewed official surfaces.
The maintainer explicitly approved the 129 monthly source lists as the qualified temporal shortage-state corpus; this does not establish complete delegated detail-page coverage.
Internet Archive payloads and FDA documentation remain internal and quarantined where Bronze integrity or rights review requires it.
Public release and external publication remain separately gated.
